meaning: Evidence classifications only. VERIFIED is not human approval, production readiness, a passed SRS acceptance criterion, or permission to set F03 method.validation_status=validated.
human_review: PENDING: H3 plus an independently qualified scientific reviewer

gates.claim: Gregorian midpoint-day offsets preserve real elapsed time and gaps on the hand-tabulated fixtures.
gates.remaining: H3 must choose the production year ruler; the reference uses an explicit 365.2425-day parameter, marked PROVISIONAL.

gates.claim: Monthly baseline means and equal-weight annual anomaly arithmetic match fixed analytic examples.
gates.remaining: Production QA/coverage eligibility and baseline minimum-count policies still need implementation and review.

gates.claim: Pairwise slopes on actual coordinates agree with exact affine/outlier/tie fixtures and SciPy.
gates.remaining: Reference agreement is not empirical coverage or production sign-off.

gates.claim: SVD least squares matches hand rational sums and independent SciPy linregress; F=t squared and the df=2 closed-form tail agree.
gates.remaining: Uncorrected inference requires independent homoscedastic errors; no serial-dependence validity is claimed.

gates.claim: Pair scores, ties and continuity-corrected normal p-values agree with complete-series pyMannKendall.
gates.remaining: Approximate p-values are not exact small-sample permutation probabilities. Full null calibration has not run.

gates.claim: An explicitly capped complete-monthly pyMannKendall comparator is available; its diagnostic alpha is fixed at 0.05.
gates.remaining: Publisher full text returned 403. Original-paper variance/lag conventions and applicability need qualified review; library agreement alone cannot certify them. The library detrends on month/observation indices, not actual elapsed midpoint days; matching the TDD requires separate coordinate-convention review.

gates.claim: No validated calendar-gap Hamed-Rao variance correction is available in this foundation.
gates.remaining: Derive/review a calendar-aware extension; run the missing-month scenarios before publication. Never compress gaps and call the result gap-aware.

gates.claim: SciPy 1.18.1 uses tie-corrected variance and nearest-even rank rounding; the six-point fixture selects one-based ranks 2 and 14.
gates.remaining: This establishes the reference rank convention, not finite-sample coverage or an autocorrelation-adjusted interval.

gates.claim: No autocorrelation-adjusted Sen CI is certified or computed here.
gates.remaining: Review the rank inversion/variance correction and calibrate coverage; a bootstrap fallback needs its own reviewed version and latency benchmark.

gates.claim: Santer printed pages 7343-7344 visually confirm effective-n, residual-variance substitution and the adjusted-df variant used by the TDD.
gates.remaining: The comparator accepts supplied rho only. Residual ACF normalization, calendar-pair treatment and the 24-pair rule need review/calibration; no residual-rho estimator is silently selected.

gates.claim: Primary extracted text identifies monthly sampling and trend per year; equation (3) and coefficient were not visually verified.
gates.remaining: Harvard PDF text was accessible, but local download was denied and screenshot returned cache miss; alternate Hamburg copy required authorization. Inspect the actual equation, sampling derivation and approximation before implementing. No horizon is calculated here.

gates.claim: Exact adjusted fractions and original-order/exclusion handling agree with the frozen family and SciPy.
gates.remaining: Dependence assumptions, complete family identity and repeated exploratory selections remain scientific limitations.

gates.claim: Analytic exact-weight examples preserve weighted numerators/denominators, missing support and true zeros.
gates.remaining: No actual geometry, masks, provider weighting or NASA global mean has been checked.

gates.claim: NTRS PDF pages 4, 17 and 22 were visually inspected: ten boxes, Table 5 outcomes and January 1998-December 2007 candidate window.
gates.remaining: Page 3 calls the span nine years; keep the discrepancy. Table 5 slope units are not explicit; do not assume a per-decade conversion.

gates.claim: No SeaWiFS observations have been acquired or reproduced.
gates.remaining: Obtain authentic versioned series, verify calendar/QA/window and published slope units, then compare monthly and annual branches separately. Modern reprocessing can differ.

gates.claim: SM-12, AC-30/31 and VL-01/02 are not complete.
gates.remaining: At least 2000 independent 300-month realizations per required scenario, full reports and human scientific sign-off are still required.
